exposure: traditional oral feeding progression based on post-menstrual age and weight
early oral feeding progression based on the Mansoura Early Feeding Skills Assessment (MEFSA)
cohort: 81 preterm infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) of Mansoura University Children Hospital (MUCH).
finding: The newly applied approach using MEFSA resulted in earlier SOF and FOF, shorter duration of tube feeding, and weight gain without increased workload for the NICU team.
